effectText:

Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the Grave.

name: Slifer the Sky Dragon
effectText:
This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. 
When Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. Cannot be targeted by card effects. Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. 
Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the Grave. 
If a Monster(s) is Summoned to your opponent’s field face-up: That Monster(s) loses 2000 ATK, then if its ATK has been reduced to 0 as a result, Destroy it.

name: The Winged Dragon of Ra
effectText:
This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. 
When Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. Cannot be targeted by card effects.  
Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the Grave. 
When Normal Summoned: You can pay LP so that you only have 100 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid. 
You can Discard 1, then target 1 Monster on the field; Destroy that target.

name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
effectText:
"Relinquished" + "Thousand-Eyes Idol" 
Other monsters on the field cannot change their battle positions or attack. 
Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead.

name: Relinquished
effectText:
“Black Illusion Ritual”
Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1).
This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead. While equipped with that monster, any battle damage you take from battles involving this card inflicts equal effect damage to your opponent.

name: Toon Harpie Lady
effectText:

effectText: Target 1 Zombie monster in your Grave; Revive that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.
